study.question: Do the compact source residual features add predictive utility to timing_joint beyond repeated inherited evidence and extra capacity under the frozen protocol?
study.hypothesis: Frozen source validation AUCs are static0.6050036, pooled0.6102261, DIN-adapted0.6133620, compact shape_magnitude0.6232923 and timing_joint0.6306854. Compact source Logloss0.1935680 and inference30.277s are also worse than timing_joint0.1926809 and26.315s. These are distinct source trajectories, not an interaction test. The compact heads retain valid missing-field/tied events and fine within-bin age moments that the supported-adjacency timing summary does not explicitly encode. This may add utility, but most ancestors and the histogram are shared, making redundancy plausible. No visible negative or abandoned trial receipts are supplied: search returned no scoped memory hits; do not infer omitted trajectories or the effect of shape orientation.

nearest_work.difference: Retain all full-parent source methods and allocations; graft only the four compact residual heads after the timing head. Reconstruct identical parent arithmetic to return shared68 context without a second embedding pass.

Inherit four residual architectures and feature formulas; omit its exchangeable backbone and train new heads after the stronger chronological/product timing source. This tests branch transfer/complementarity, not exact late fusion of two complete frozen checkpoints.

DIN uses candidate-conditioned weighted history pooling with unnormalized activation; supplied reference instead normalizes softmax and substitutes category/brand/action/time. Graft uses inherited target-match cell statistics and context gates, not a new DIN query or faithful DIN reproduction.
Only author README verified; fields contain category, brand and behavior type without item. No full-paper mechanism verification or DMR reproduction claim.

nearest_work.difference: Direct readout and parallel evidence have prior precedent. Here context gates are inherited, no per-layer FM highway, bus fusion, auxiliary delay target, optimizer change or mutual distillation is added. Its bus-fusion removal improved AUC but worsened Logloss in tiny mode, so combination alone is not mechanistic evidence or a transferable guarantee.

inherited_components: Complete timing_joint hierarchy, including static/history pooling, match histogram, independent moments, field contrasts, identity/context/repeat/overlap heads, chronological/product transitions, direct/lifted pooled gap branch and joint gap/endpoint-age head
Source compact histogram head, conditional within-bin mean head, observed population variance head, magnitude central-third head with68-coordinate context modulation
All supplied event support and coarse thresholds3600/86400/604800, history limit128; no item identity, extra history or labels
study.proposed_difference: Append the four compact heads after timing_joint; reuse one inherited backbone/context computation. Change only their selected64-coordinate inputs across compact, histogram duplicates, timing duplicates, and zero. Histogram control repeats inherited64 histogram for every head. Timing control tiles inherited16 joint timing coordinates four times scaled0.5 (norm-preserving), then uses that64-vector for every head. Zero executes all features and heads but has identically zero bias-free residual. Allocated capacity and execution are matched; effective rank, norms and trainable utilization are not claimed matched.
predictions: Compact validation AUC exceeds both source bests, especially0.6306853561, and exceeds both active redundant-input controls; seed42 alone remains provisional.

Added mean/variance/shape inputs differ from inherited histograms on controlled same-histogram witnesses; distinction demonstrates representational access, not predictive utility or information absent from the entire timing backbone.

Zero-graft source parity is within floating arithmetic tolerance at the same checkpoint; all modes have17270419 parameters and initial logits equal timing_joint with same seed. Host must verify actual gradients/logits.

Report unweighted Logloss, full frozen slices with sample/positive/negative counts, train and wall seconds, allocated GPU seconds if supplied, examples, memory, throughput and batch p50/p95. Increased cost can negate efficiency despite AUC gains.

Build a measured validation-quality/cost frontier across submitted cells and both frozen source models using host training/allocated GPU time and inference measurements; distinguish concurrent matched-execution controls from historical sources. Do not equate matched parameter count with equal compute or infer an equal-compute gain from the fixed3-epoch comparison.
falsifiers: Compact fails to exceed timing_joint, or any gain is equaled by histogram/timing duplication: no compact-evidence utility support in this implementation.
Zero branch changes the parent computation or source hashes/config differ: invalid contrast, retain failed cost and repair only if admissible.
Host diagnostics show oracle, support, finite output or invariance failures: performance alone cannot support the proposed mechanism.
A positive seed42 difference disappears or reverses in paired43/44: no repeated support.
Higher AUC with worse Logloss or measured cost must be reported as a tradeoff, not an unqualified gain.
alternative_explanations: Extra readout capacity or different feature scaling/rank and optimization could explain gains.
Fine-time statistics may overlap learned recency embeddings or other inherited heads; no proof of statistical independence.

Replacing exchangeable backbone with chronological/product changes the compact heads initialization stream relative to their source; controlled within-graft comparisons preserve the stream, source comparisons are whole-model utility contrasts.
Within-impression gates may exploit redundant target/history context; no new gating mechanism is being attributed.
Frozen validation repeated selection and one seed can overstate utility; user-cluster uncertainty is unavailable unless host supplies paired resampling.
Static snapshot dates are undocumented, category/brand are coarse, and conclusions apply only to this causal-prefix benchmark/protocol.
